{{DISPLAYTITLE:masimage}}
'''masimage''' (also printed '''Masimage''') is an artist whose image is used on six [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards print the credit as "Image courtesy of Masimage" and "Image courtesy of masimage @ DeviantArt". The credit points to DeviantArt, an online art community. The credited cards are [[First Order Stormtrooper]], [[FN-2003|•FN-2003]], [[Force Freeze|•Force Freeze]], [[Sidon Ithano|•Sidon Ithano]], [[CC-2237 (Odd Ball)|•CC-2237 (Odd Ball)]], and [[Lt. Poldin Lehuse|•Lt. Poldin Lehuse]], in [[Virtual Set 4]], [[Virtual Set 7]], [[Virtual Set 8]], and [[Virtual Set 11]] (released 2016–2019).
